text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C after a steep loss may have eased the immediate worry, but I should decide based on its future prospects and portfolio role—not the urge to avoid seeing a loss or to get back to my average cost.","My account rebounded after a sharp decline, reminding me that reacting to short-term moves can be costly; I should weigh the evidence and risks before trading, while accepting that holding can also be a deliberate choice.","Even when I trade rarely, I should review my holdings and overall diversification often enough to catch meaningful changes and keep the portfolio’s risk appropriate for me."]}
